text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 pager triggered for cluster rp-west-3: nccl_collective_timeout detected across multiple TP4 jobs. Alert group: nccl.partyline.timeout. Paging oncall_sre_lee.

oncall_sre_lee: I'm on it, acknowledging pager. Can folks post the alert link and affected nodes?

ml-runtime-anya: Alert -> https://redwood.ops/alerts/2823456789. Seen for three separate pipeline-parallel jobs (model: gptx-7b-tp4) over the last ~90s. Failing op: allreduce (ring) hang with communicator id 0x7f9ca.

infra_jordan: Nodes flagged: gpu-22, gpu-24, gpu-26 (same PG). NVLINK peer status shows intermittent link resets. Kernel logs have repeated Xid_79 entries around the timestamps. Posting snippet: 
```
[ 12345.678901] GPU 2: Xid 79: page fault on read from 0x0
[ 12345.679002] process learner[3456] triggered watchdog
[ 12345.679110] nccl: fatal error 7 on rank 1 -> aborting
```

oncall_sre_lee: Thanks. Initial mitigation: mark these nodes in maintenance so new jobs don't land, and attempt draining running containers gracefully. Maya, can you start a rolling restart of the runtime on that PG and disable async_comm for a test?

oncall_tier2_maya: Will do. Disabling NCCL_ASYNC_SUPPORT and setting NCCL_LAUNCH_MODE=GROUP on the runtime config for the affected pool, then redeploying. Command I ran: 
```bash
kubectl -n rp patch cm runtime-config --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/nccl_async_support","value":"false"}]'
kubectl -n rp rollout restart ds/gpu-runtime-pg-22
```

prodops_mike: FYI customer-visible impact: hosted inference latency spikes and ~10% 5xx rate for a subset of customers using long-context chat. Incidents correlate with time slices 14:02:10–14:03:40 UTC. Support Rita, heads-up for CS.

support_rita: Acknowledged. I'll open a CC ticket for affected customers and prepare an incident banner draft. Any advice on ETA for recovery?

ml-runtime-anya: After disabling async and switching to GROUP launch, one job recovered but two still hang. We observed KV-cache memory growth on those ranks before crash; suspect a leak combined with reduced NIC throughput -> collective stall.

oncall_sre_lee: Can you get a core dump or full nccl trace? If not, lower frag size and force fallback to GDR_DISABLE for NVLink to see if it lifts.

infra_jordan: Captured nccl debug logs from learner PIDs and core dumps. Uploading to /mnt/diag/2823456789/. Also toggled environment: NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=0 on the pool for testing.

incident-bot: Attachments uploaded: 3 files (nccl_log_1.tgz, core_gpu22.tar.gz, perf_counters.csv).

oncall_tier2_maya: After GDR_DISABLE, one of the stuck jobs made progress and completed allreduces. Remaining job still blocked on rendezvous (rank mismatch). I'm going to kill the job to restore resources; needs escalation if it recurs.

ml-runtime-anya: Killing job now: `pkill -f \"model=gptx-7b.*jobid=835\"` — reclaimed 4 GPUs. Resource pool showed immediate drop in queue latency.

prodops_mike: Good. Can we put an automatic fallback: if nccl collective stalls for >60s, autoscaler should try model-variant fallback to cpu-streaming or smaller TP degree? We had customer errors because retries hit same pool.

oncall_sre_lee: Agree - adding a short-term mitigation: add a policy to route new TP4 jobs to alternative PGs not matching the same fabric. Also enabling conservative batching on the API layer for affected customers.

support_rita: Draft banner: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors and latency for long-context embeddings in rp-west-3. Some requests may fail or be delayed. Working on mitigation; updates every 30 minutes." Approve? :eyes:

prodops_mike: Approve. Include ETA: next update 14:35 UTC.

ml-runtime-anya: Root hypothesis: intermittent NVLINK hardware errors (Xid_79) + aggressive NCCL async ops causing races in rendezvous -> hangs. Evidence: repeated NVLINK resets, Xid loglines, recovery when disabling GDR/async.

oncall_tier2_maya: Next steps: 1) keep GDR disabled for the PG for 2 hours, 2) isolate affected nodes for hardware triage, 3) run stress nccl tests on spare nodes with same driver to reproduce. I'll coordinate hardware ticket with infra_jordan.

infra_jordan: Opening CHASSIS ticket for NVLINK firmware check and probing the PCI-E topology on gpu-22/24/26. Also bumping driver to 535.86 in a canary before mass rollout.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated (partial), severity=P2 due to customer retries. Paging oncall_sre_lee for handoff at 15:00 UTC.

oncall_sre_lee: I'm handing off to oncall_tier2_maya for the rest of the afternoon. Leaving notes: logs and dumps at /mnt/diag/2823456789, GDR disabled on pool rp-west-3-pg-7, nodes gpu-22/24/26 cordoned, actions taken: job kill, runtime rollout, NCCL env tweaks.

oncall_tier2_maya: Taking over. I'll monitor the pool and run extended nccl stress overnight. If we see recurrence, we'll fail traffic over to rp-east-1 and start a deeper kernel/firmware debug with vendor.

support_rita: I'll post the customer banner now and start triage tickets with affected accounts; collecting logs and request IDs.

prodops_mike: Postmortem owners: ml-runtime-anya, infra_jordan, oncall_tier2_maya. Please prepare a short incident timeline and an initial RCA within 72 hours.

oncall_tier2_maya: Will do. Preliminary mitigation note: set NCCL_ASYNC_SUPPORT=false globally for impacted PGs until hardware validated.

ml-runtime-anya: One more metric: KV-cache hit ratio dropped during hang, token throughput collapsed to zero for the blocked ranks — saved traces in diag.

incident-bot: Handoff completed. Next update pinned to thread at 15:00 UTC.

oncall_tier2_maya: Quick follow-up: scheduling firmware probe for tomorrow 09:00 local; keeping nodes cordoned until clearance. If anyone wants to reallocate capacity, ping me before 09:00.

support_rita: Banner posted and customers notified. Will consolidate affected request IDs and share a spreadsheet in #support.

prodops_mike: Thanks team. If anyone finds a quick patch to make NCCL more tolerant (config snippet, retry loop) please post it here.

ml-runtime-anya: Adding a temporary code guard for collective rendezvous timeouts: if rendezvous stalls >45s, abort and fallback to pairwise reduce. I'll open a PR and milestone it to hotfix.

oncall_tier2_maya: Acknowledged. Leaving monitoring in place. I'll update the thread if we get recurrence. :slightly_smiling_face:
